title: Stay at the Bleeker 30A Cottage Rental | Rosemary Beach Cottage Rentals – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description:
"Welcome to your own private resort within Rosemary Beach®. A must see south of 30A,close to the beach! This beautiful space is perfect for entertaining or relaxing. Book now!
"
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Welcome to your own private resort within Rosemary Beach®. A must see south of 30A,close to the beach! Bleeker Cottage has large, inviting porches spanning the length of the property. The outdoor living/entertainment area offers a pool,spa, water fountain and outdoor summer kitchen (natural gas grill, refrigerator and sink). This beautiful space is perfect for entertaining or relaxing.

The entry level of the home has a large living space which encompasses the eat in kitchen, dining area and a 1/2 bath in hallway. The kitchen has a Wolfe range even a master chef would enjoy. This first floor living space has a gas fireplace, flat screen tv and available surround sound. A major bonus at Bleeker Cottage is the two master bedrooms, one of which is located on the first floor adjacent to the living, dining and kitchen area.

Another master bedroom plus two additional guest bedrooms are located on the second level. A large gathering space is adjacent to the three bedrooms on the second floor and opens onto the second level balcony. This gathering area is a fun place for watching TV, playing games, etc.

Parking pad for two vehicles.

For a bird's eye view of the rooftops of Rosemary Beach®, travel up the winding spiral staircase to an open-air widow's walk. Truly one of a kind!

DURING SPRING BREAK AND SUMMER, THIS PROPERTY RENTS FOR 7 OR 14 NIGHTS FROM SATURDAY-SATURDAY.

Pool can be heated October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee.
